name: Nebula Blossom Observatory
description: An observatory perched on a cliff, surrounded by blooming nebula‑cloud flowers that pulse with cosmic color.
prompt: A futuristic observatory with a domed telescope on a rugged cliff edge. Around it, enormous blossom‑like nebulae unfurl — petals of ionized gas in magenta, cyan, gold — glowing and slowly rotating. Stars pepper the background. Cinematic, volumetric lighting, 8K.
caption: Where astronomy meets botanical wonder. 🌠🌸 #NebulaBlossomObservatory
